missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend standalone choline until dietary intake and prenatal product contents are reviewed.
safety_exclusions: Do not infer choline deficiency from pregnancy alone.
Do not duplicate choline already present in prenatal or other products.
Do not replace antenatal nutritional care with a supplement suggestion.
professional_escalation_conditions: Pregnancy with complicated medical/nutritional status, multiple supplements or clinician-prescribed products.
population_and_context: Pregnant people; choline needs increase during pregnancy, but dietary intake and prenatal product composition vary.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Compare total dietary and supplemental intake with pregnancy-specific reference values and upper limits.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Choline fact sheet provides pregnancy reference intake and sources; dietary assessment is required before supplement decisions. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
